correctness.rationale: From independent Bernoulli state matrices and conditional E[e_new|history]=0, c_k=E[x_ke_k]=E[e_k^2] for k>=1. Reconstructed the exact 2x2 covariance recursion N with entries 1-2h+h^2/p, (1+2h)/p-2, (1-p)h^2/p, (1-p)(1+2h)/p; verified determinant (1-p)(1-2h^2)/p, trace and three Jury expressions. The only binding Jury inequality is h[4p-2-(3-2p)h]/p>0. When it fails for 0<p<1, N has strictly positive entries in the excluded region and a positive nonzero residual-free first-step moment vector; Perron-Frobenius prevents x mean square from vanishing. p=1 reduces to deterministic gradient descent, 0<h<2. Memoryless baseline has multiplier 1-2h+h^2/p, stability 0<h<2p. Endpoints included as non-convergent, not inferred from finite tests.
